name: Goldshire custom quests: the map marks each objective area, not only the turn-in
contract: Quests 100071 'Defias Disruption', 1660056 'Agria's Medicine', 1660057 'Seven Years of Bad Luck', 1660058 'Worm-Eaten Apple', 1660059 'Goldshire's Generosity' and 1660060 'Stay a While' carried only the turn-in pin rev_20260924_60 wrote and 17001 'Extravagant Order' no POI at all, so a player with one open saw nothing on the world map for where to go (#6977, #6982). This case asks the server for each quest's points with the CMSG_QUEST_POI_QUERY a real client sends and reads SMSG_QUEST_POI_QUERY_RESPONSE itself. A control query for 17003, which the character does not carry, must come back empty. Each carried quest must answer with its turn-in pin (id 0, ObjectiveIndex -1) followed by one rectangle per objective in Elwynn Forest (WorldMapAreaId 30): the Defias bandits and rogue wizards at the Bandit's Bastion for 100071 (ObjectiveIndex 0 and 1), the four market vendors for 1660056 (ObjectiveIndex 4-7), the Mirror Shards at the Spada manor for 1660057, the Kobold Warrens west of Goldshire for 1660058, the pumpkin, melon and apple patches for 1660059 (ObjectiveIndex 4-6), Aliscar's Arcane Projection for 1660060 (ObjectiveIndex 0) and the Jasperlode Mine spiders for 17001 (ObjectiveIndex 4). 17001 also gets the turn-in pin at Tharynn Bouden.
